publication_rules: This package is an editorial research draft, not a live CMS import or published admission notice.
Prepare all content types; do not equate section coverage with verification of every volatile fact.
Use current-year official fee/admission evidence where available and keep older-year information labelled.
Do not transplant a university-wide placement claim into an agriculture programme outcome.
A missing optional fact remains missing instead of being replaced with an estimate.
Preserve 19 independent college identities under the existing university route family.
Write from researched factual notes rather than copying or lightly rewording another publisher's prose.
